description: painterly pixel art in the style of Eastward, 3/4 top-down view with fronts drawn straight-on (not isometric), sunlight from the upper left, full value range, hue-shifted colour ramps, adaptive dark coloured outlines (never pure black), chunky readable silhouette, calm interior masses with one or two accent details, contemporary 2026-era camping object, single object cut-out on transparent background, nothing cropped at the edges, no text or letters
